o1: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Involved in protein localization and maintenance of cell polarity. Is located in the cell cortex, including the posterior cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and reproductive system. Is part of the CDC-42 signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with cdc-42. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Duane retraction syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including CHN1 (chimerin 1).
